name: Magnus Vestergaard
bio:
Magnus's fascination with motorsport began in his youth, watching his father tinker with rally cars. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics, from the Technical University of Denmark. His early career involved a stint with a small Formula Ford team, where he quickly gained a reputation for meticulousness and innovative problem-solving. From there, he progressed to Formula Renault, contributing significantly to several race-winning campaigns. 

He joined ART Grand Prix Academy five years ago, initially as a senior engineer, rapidly ascending to the role of Technical Director. Magnus is known for his data-driven approach and his ability to translate complex engineering concepts into actionable strategies for the track. He is a demanding leader, pushing his team to achieve perfection, but also fosters a culture of continuous improvement and collaborative problem-solving. His focus on marginal gains and his commitment to exploring cutting-edge technologies set him apart.

physical.description: A tall, lean man with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly aligned monitor setup in his office.
